description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for a language selection screen in a mobile app. It allows users to select a language from a list, persists their choice using shared preferences, and navigates to an OTP validation screen upon confirmation.

classes.name: LanguageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a UI for users to select a language from a predefined list. It manages the selected language state and handles navigation to the OTP validation screen.

classes.name: _LanguageScreenState
classes.description: The state class for LanguageScreen, managing the UI interactions, selected language state, and persistence of user selection.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for this widget.

methods.name: _onNext
methods.description: Handles the action when the user presses the 'NEXT' button; saves language preference and navigates to OTP validation screen.
